releases.author: nataka620
releases.description:
Initial public release of GoalToDo.

Highlights:
- Hierarchical GOAL and TODO management directly in Markdown
- Automatic parent state and progress aggregation
- Due dates, completion timestamps, priorities, and assignees
- Filterable and sortable task-focused view
- No proprietary task database

Support development: https://ko-fi.com/orikatha
